content: Gemini 2 (MacPaw user guide): Smart Cleanup removes only exact duplicates from summary screen; similars never auto-selected; selection filters Automatically/Newest/Oldest/Any/Manual per group or per file; Always Select / Never Select folder lists; Ignore List (files, folders, extensions); selecting last instance requires 'Remove Last Instance' confirmation (allowed); removal modes Trash (default)/Move to folder/Permanent, optional replace-with-hardlink, remove empty folders; post-clean 'Review Trashed' with Put Back / Put All Back only within current session; volumes without Trash -> warns permanent only; Duplicates Monitor menu-bar agent watches cleaned folders, notifies on new exact copies with Review/Remove(to Trash)/Add to Ignore List actions.
